name: MonarchAiTonePicker
title: AiTonePicker
wrapsNative: Button rows with the isSelected trait (cards); Picker with .pickerStyle(.menu) (compact); MonarchTextField for the custom tone
summary: Chooses the tone the assistant writes in: Professional, Technical, Casual and Executive by default, each with a one-line description, and an optional custom tone in the person's own words.
whenToUse: In assistant settings or a compose screen where the person picks how generated text should read. Use the compact variant in toolbars and dense forms.
whenNotToUse: For any other single choice use the standard Picker (see radio-group). Inside a Form or List where plain rows are expected, a Picker with the inline style fits better.
api: MonarchAiTonePicker.init(selection: Binding<String>, customText: Binding<String>? = nil, tones: [MonarchAiTone] = MonarchAiTone.defaults, variant: MonarchAiTonePickerVariant = .cards, label: String? = nil, customLabel: String? = nil, customDetail: String? = nil, customFieldLabel: String? = nil, customPrompt: String? = nil)
MonarchAiTone.init(id: String, label: String, detail: String)

options.name: selection
options.description: The id of the selected tone, or MonarchAiTone.customID for the Custom option.

options.name: customText
options.description: The person's own description. Passing a binding adds the Custom option and, while it is selected, a text field.

options.name: tones
options.description: The tones to offer, each with an id, a label and a one-line detail.

options.name: variant
options.description: cards: one row per tone with its description. compact: a menu Picker.

options.name: label
options.description: Replaces the built-in name of the choice, "Tone".

options.name: customLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in name of the Custom option.

options.name: customDetail
options.description: Replaces the built-in description of the Custom option.

options.name: customFieldLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in label of the custom text field.

options.name: customPrompt
options.description: Replaces the built-in placeholder of the custom text field.

states.name: selected
states.description: The row has the assistant subtle fill, a 2-point assistant border and a filled radio mark.

states.name: not selected
states.description: A surface row with a 1-point border and an empty radio mark.

states.name: custom selected
states.description: A MonarchTextField for the custom tone appears under the options.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Rows use the disabled text role and do not respond, with the standard disabled(_:) modifier. The selected row keeps a stronger border and the filled mark.

states.name: compact
states.description: A label and the system menu picker on one line.

appearance: Rows sit on the surface colour with the default border. The selected row uses the assistant (ai) subtle fill, border and strong mark colour in every theme; the high-contrast themes resolve the same roles to stronger colours.
platformNotes: The web lays the cards out in a grid of columns at least 176px wide; on iOS they are one column, which holds at every text size. The web's compact variant is a native select, here the system menu Picker. The web's uncontrolled custom text (defaultCustomText) is not offered: pass a binding. Android uses the same names.
accessibility: In cards each row is a button read as the tone name, with the description as its hint and the selected trait on the current tone.
The selected row is also marked by a filled radio symbol and a thicker border, not by colour alone.
The rows are one container labelled with the name of the choice; the visible legend is not read twice.
Every row is at least 44 points high, and its text wraps at large text sizes.
The compact variant is the system Picker, labelled with the name of the choice.
The custom field is a MonarchTextField with its own label.
The selection change is not animated when Reduce Motion is on.
edgeCases: A selection that matches no tone shows no row as selected.
A tone whose id is "custom" is dropped while the Custom option is shown, so ids stay unique.
A tone with an empty detail shows only its label.
The custom text is kept when another tone is selected; the app decides whether to use it.

examples.title: Cards with a custom tone
examples.template:
MonarchAiTonePicker(
    selection: $tone,
    customText: $customText,
    tones: [
        MonarchAiTone(id: {{tones.0.id}}, label: {{tones.0.label}}, detail: {{tones.0.description}}),
        MonarchAiTone(id: {{tones.1.id}}, label: {{tones.1.label}}, detail: {{tones.1.description}}),
        MonarchAiTone(id: {{tones.2.id}}, label: {{tones.2.label}}, detail: {{tones.2.description}}),
        MonarchAiTone(id: {{tones.3.id}}, label: {{tones.3.label}}, detail: {{tones.3.description}}),
    ],
    label: {{messages.label}},
    customLabel: {{messages.custom}},
    customDetail: {{messages.customDescription}}
)
examples.setupTemplate:
@State private var tone = {{value}}
@State private var customText = ""
examples.setup:
@State private var tone = "professional"
@State private var customText = ""
examples.code:
MonarchAiTonePicker(
    selection: $tone,
    customText: $customText,
    tones: [
        MonarchAiTone(id: "professional", label: "Professional", detail: "Clear, polite and to the point."),
        MonarchAiTone(id: "technical", label: "Technical", detail: "Precise terms, detail and structure."),
        MonarchAiTone(id: "casual", label: "Casual", detail: "Friendly and conversational."),
        MonarchAiTone(id: "executive", label: "Executive", detail: "Short, decision-first, no detail."),
    ],
    label: "Tone",
    customLabel: "Custom",
    customDetail: "Describe the tone in your own words."
)

examples.title: With a custom tone
examples.setup:
@State private var tone = MonarchAiTone.customID
@State private var custom = ""

examples.title: Compact, with your own tones
examples.code:
MonarchAiTonePicker(
    selection: $tone,
    tones: [
        MonarchAiTone(id: "short", label: "Short", detail: "Two sentences at most."),
        MonarchAiTone(id: "detailed", label: "Detailed", detail: "Every step, with reasons."),
    ],
    variant: .compact,
    label: "Length"
)
